question: When is the application due?
expected: There are multiple receipt cycles, all due by 5:00 PM local time of the applicant organization; the last listed dates are June 08, 2026, October 08, 2026, and February 08, 2027 (new) / March 08, 2027 (resubmission), and the NOFO expires May 08, 2027.
quote: All applications are due by 5:00 PM local time of applicant organization.

question: How much money does the award give besides salary?
expected: NIDCD contributes $40,000 per year toward research development costs, plus salary up to the legislatively mandated salary cap; indirect costs are reimbursed at 8% of modified total direct costs.

question: How do my reference letters get submitted?
expected: Reference letters are required (applications lacking them will not be reviewed) and are submitted directly by referees through the eRA Commons Submit Referee Information link, not through Grants.gov.
